description: Update a DRAFT broadcast. True PATCH — only the fields you pass are written. ⚠️ Drafts only: a queued broadcast returns 409 not_draft, because editing it would change what the composer shows without changing a single already-queued message.

audience.description: WHO to send to, expressed as a QUERY rather than a resolved address list. A draft stores the filters, so reopening it re-resolves against current data — an audience that grew between composing and sending is not silently under-sent.

board_id.description: mode='crm': restrict to one CRM board. Omit for every contact the tenant owns.

email_status.description: mode='crm': 'valid' (default) keeps only SpiderVerify-confirmed addresses. Switching to 'any' is the most common cause of a bounce-rate breach — it mails unverified addresses.

require_first_name.description: mode='crm': drop contacts with no first_name so {{first_name}} never renders empty.

topics.description: mode='subscribers': restrict to these topics. Empty/omitted = all topics.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601, or null to clear the intended send time.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: send_update_broadcast
